messages.content: Could you tell me how to obtain just the IDs and context attributes, and not all the details, of the CAA records for 'sample2.com'? I'll be using my API key 'secret567'.

message.content:
Sure! To retrieve only the IDs and context attributes for the CAA records of `sample2.com`, you can use the following API call:

```http
GET https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/dns_records?type=CAA&name=sample2.com HTTP/1.1
Host: api.cloudflare.com
Authorization: Bearer secret567
Accept: application/json
```

Replace `{zone_id}` with your actual zone ID. This request will return a list of DNS records filtered by type `CAA` and name `sample2.com`. The response will include each record’s `id` and `context` attributes (if present), but it will not include the full record details.

If you want to further limit the fields returned, you can add a `fields` query parameter:

```http
GET https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/dns_records?type=CAA&name=sample2.com&fields=id,context HTTP/1.1
```

This will ensure that only the `id` and `context` fields are returned in the response.
